customManagers.description: The FOUNDRY_VERSION default in docker-compose.test.yml decides which Foundry build the felddy image downloads at container start; the docker-compose manager sees only the image tag (#233).

packageRules.description: Move the felddy/foundryvtt image tag and the FOUNDRY_VERSION default in one PR (#233), and hold it for approval on the Dependency Dashboard: the modifyDocument wire shape is unverified past 13.348 (#232) and the integration tier does not run in CI (#183), so a FoundryVTT bump has to be approved deliberately.
Leave package.json engines alone: the package is published to npm, and an exact engines pin such as v26.13.0 (#235) makes npm warn or refuse to install for consumers on any other Node version.
